candidates.summary: The Trump administration sued California election officials, seeking to prevent the counting of mail ballots from 20,000 people the federal government described as likely noncitizens until their status is verified. California’s secretary of state said the government had not provided evidence supporting the claim and that the state was complying with federal law.
candidates.title: Trump administration sues California over disputed voter list

candidates.summary: The FBI and U.S. Postal Inspection Service said they were investigating suspicious mailings sent nationwide, including to congressional, secretary of state and election offices. Some letters contained unknown substances, prompting election-office evacuations in Louisiana and Oklahoma. Tests found powder received by Wisconsin’s election commission was not hazardous.
candidates.title: Federal agencies investigate suspicious mailings to election offices

candidates.summary: The U.S. Producer Price Index for final demand rose a seasonally adjusted 1.3% in September, its largest monthly increase since March 2022, and was 6.3% higher than a year earlier. Goods prices increased 2.6% and services prices rose 0.8%, with energy and transportation costs contributing to the acceleration.
candidates.title: U.S. wholesale prices rise 1.3% in September

candidates.summary: U.S. retail sales rose 0.8% in September after a revised 1.3% increase in August, the Commerce Department reported. Sales excluding gasoline stations increased 0.2%, while gasoline-station receipts rose 6.4%. The figures are not adjusted for inflation.
candidates.title: U.S. retail sales rise 0.8% as gasoline spending jumps

candidates.summary: Pope Leo XIV resumed working from a Rome hospital and met with a senior Vatican aide two days after surgeons removed the lower lobe of his right lung. His doctors said the operated lung was recovering well and post-operative tests were normal, but tests were still pending to determine whether the cancer had spread or required further treatment.
candidates.title: Pope Leo resumes work as doctors report expected recovery

candidates.summary: Houthi-launched missiles and drones struck near the palace used by Yemen’s internationally recognized government in Aden, killing at least two people and wounding six, according to an official. The Houthis claimed responsibility, while officials said government leaders in the city were safe.
candidates.title: Houthi strikes near Aden government palace kill two

candidates.summary: A private school roof collapsed during classes in Peshawar, killing 34 children and a teacher, according to an updated Associated Press account. More than 50 people were injured as rescue crews searched the rubble.
candidates.title: Peshawar school roof collapse kills 34 children and teacher

candidates.summary: A global sell-off in artificial-intelligence-related shares sent South Korea’s Kospi down 7.6% and Japan’s Nikkei 225 down 4.9%. U.S. stocks recovered by the close: the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 556.21 points to 52,177.69, while the Nasdaq Composite added 20.16 points to 26,713.03.
candidates.title: Wall Street recovers after steep AI-driven losses in Asia
